links.outcome: Patient knowledge, confidence, and understanding with simplified vs original CT report impressions
links.effect: Simplified report group had significantly better knowledge of primary site and disease extent and higher confidence and understanding (P < .05 for all).
links.quote: In phase II, simplified report group patients demonstrated significantly better knowledge of primary site and extent of their disease as well as showed significantly higher confidence and understanding of the report (P < .05 for all).

links.outcome: Radiologist review catching errors in LLM-simplified reports before release
links.effect: Radiologist supervision identified 3 of 50 simplified reports requiring corrections before provision to patients.
links.quote: Only three (of 50) simplified reports required corrections by the radiologist.
